exemptions.test: resolves when the index reports ready
exemptions.reason: Resolving is the whole claim, and the await enforces it. Paired with the sibling 'throws when the index never becomes ready'.

exemptions.test: should not throw on network error
exemptions.reason: Not throwing is the claim in the title, and the await enforces it. triggerDownload returns void, so there is no result to inspect.

exemptions.test: should handle clean when output directory does not exist
exemptions.reason: Tolerating a missing directory is the claim, and the await enforces it. There is no directory to inspect afterwards.

exemptions.test: accepts root notes and registered entity directories
exemptions.reason: Acceptance means validateSeedContentEntityTypes does not reject. Counterpart to 'rejects every seeded type the brain did not register'.

exemptions.test: ignores hidden metadata and directories without sync files
exemptions.reason: Ignoring means not rejecting, which the await enforces. Counterpart to the rejection case in the same file.

exemptions.test: should not fail when nothing to commit
exemptions.reason: An empty commit must not throw. That is the claim, and the await enforces it.

exemptions.test: registers and unregisters callbacks without error
exemptions.reason: Proving the callbacks fire needs sendMessageToChannel, which is protected; reaching it would require the cast this repo forbids in tests. The title was narrowed to what is actually verified.

exemptions.test: deployable site and theme inventory declares brain compatibility
exemptions.reason: A manifest with no dependencies key genuinely satisfies 'react is not a dependency', so the absent-subject case is the intended pass. The peer entries above are pinned with toBeString.
